'''Shil Kaval''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was a citizen of [[Athar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> he and his girlfriend [[Merish Hath]] met with [[Hallena Devis|Orla Taman]], who was revealed to be an undercover agent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Together, they participated, along with local rebels, in an uprising against the Republic-aligned [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the planet, who had risen up in support for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When Devis's position as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] was revealed, Kaval, along with [[Varti]] and Hath took her hostage. When the Republic strike team arrived to rescue Devis, Kaval was shot by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].
